scope: All generated and reused UTF-8 payload files, including decoded JSON contents and full carried review records.
allowed_content: Authorized project source paths, public GitHub links, exact source/review hashes, values, scoped review rationale, reproducibility code and historical test evidence.
excluded_content: Credentials, secret values, private links, execution-local paths, internal control identifiers and unrelated private data.
qualification: Scoped semantic inspection plus targeted checks; not a universal secret-detection guarantee.
